passages.title: Expressing Opinions and Supporting Reasons
passages.text: During a student council meeting, Rani suggested opening the library thirty minutes earlier. She explained that some students arrived at school before their first lesson and wanted a quiet place to read. Bima agreed that early access would be useful, but he wondered whether librarians needed extra preparation time. Rani proposed a one-week trial and suggested collecting feedback from staff and students. The group decided to discuss the trial with the librarians rather than changing the schedule immediately.
